name: مريضة كليتها ضعيفة — الجرعة أعلى من المسموح
name_en: Weak kidneys — dose above the limit

patient.diagnosis: Metastatic colorectal cancer — CT chest/abdomen/pelvis for staging and treatment response
patient.note: Creatinine stated by the reviewing radiologist as 2.6 mg/dL, converted at 88.4. Their hand estimate was eGFR 22; the CKD-EPI equation the MOH protocol prints (p. 21) returns 19.1 from the same creatinine. Samaam reports its own computation rather than a number entered upstream — the difference between estimating equations is exactly why it recomputes. Either value is severe CKD.

requested.study: CT Chest, Abdomen & Pelvis with contrast

expected_checks.detail: CTDIvol 18.0 > 14 and DLP 900 > 706 for adult abdomen & pelvis. Binding on providers by Royal Decree 60057 approving Health Council Resolution 3/88.
eGFR 19.1 < 30 and not on maintenance dialysis. Patient is eligible for prophylaxis, none ordered. CA-AKI risk in this band is approximately 30%.
Category II: eGFR < 30 with metformin. Must be stopped at or before the exam and suspended 48 hours, not reinstituted until renal function normalises.
Active platinum chemotherapy plus NSAID at eGFR < 30. Protocol advises withholding non-essential nephrotoxic agents 24-48h before and 48h after.

safe_alternative.prophylaxis: Isotonic saline prophylaxis per MOH protocol prior to and after the study
safe_alternative.metformin: Hold metformin at the exam and for 48 hours; reassess renal function before restarting
safe_alternative.consider: Non-contrast CT or MRI if the clinical question permits
safe_alternative.provenance: No single contrast volume is correct for every patient — volume and rate follow the study, the patient's weight, the agent and the scanner protocol. Samaam therefore never blocks on volume. It holds on dose above the national investigation level and on the renal risk category, both of which are cited.

expected_action_note: Held for authorisation, not prohibited. Contrast may still be indicated in metastatic disease; the radiologist decides. Samaam stops the protocol from executing unreviewed.
expected_checks_note: Illustrative narrative. The live response is the source of truth for every number; never chart from this block.
